nodes.summary: Exploded HRM architecture diagram HTML (33,597 chars) showing detailed component breakdown: Frontend (Next.js), Backend (Spring Boot), AI Service (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, Nginx, and inter-service communication flows with API endpoints and data flows.

nodes.name: architecture-hrm.html
nodes.summary: HRM system architecture diagram HTML (29,011 chars) showing high-level overview: 3-tier architecture (Presentation: Next.js/React, Application: Spring Boot + FastAPI AI, Data: PostgreSQL/Redis/MinIO), authentication flow (JWT + refresh tokens), and deployment topology (Docker Compose / Kubernetes).

nodes.name: auth-token-lifecycle.html
nodes.summary: Authentication token lifecycle diagram HTML (16,627 chars) illustrating JWT access token (15min) + refresh token (7d) flow: login → token pair issuance → access token usage → expiry → refresh token rotation → new token pair → logout/revocation. Shows Spring Security filter chain integration.

nodes.name: database-hrm-erd.html
nodes.summary: HRM database ERD diagram HTML (24,317 chars) showing entity relationships: Users, Departments, Jobs, Salaries, Assets, AssetRequests, AssetAssignments, ITTickets, Attendance, Overtime, Leave, Payroll, PerformanceReviews, PerformanceScores, Resignations, Holidays, WorkShifts. Includes FK relationships and key indexes.

nodes.name: resignation-flow.html
nodes.summary: Resignation workflow diagram HTML (14,011 chars) showing end-to-end process: Employee submits resignation → Manager approval → HR review → Exit interview scheduling → Asset return checklist → Final settlement calculation → Offboarding completion → Account deactivation. Includes state transitions and notification triggers.
